newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0431 per dollar in quiet trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0430 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market late in the day.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Wednesday surplus of $220 million.
Some dealers expect a new lowering in the real-dollar mini-band this week. The current mini-band was set on Tuesday between 1.0430 and 1.0480 per dollar.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real dropped 0.03 percent to close at 1.0487 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 1.09 percent to end at 1.110 per greenback.
Traders said the real's drop in part reflected a rate adjustment to the 0.2 percent CPMF tax on financial transactions, which will take effect on Thursday.
